models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_guests
models.description: Temporary guest accounts identified by device for viewing public content without registration. This table stores device-specific identifiers to enable anonymous access and tracking of guest sessions without requiring user registration.

plainFields.name: device_id
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the guest device (used for session tracking).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was marked as deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_guest_sessions
models.description:
Short-lived session tokens for anonymous guest access with 30-minute inactivity timeout.

Stores connection metadata for unauthenticated users navigating the platform, including IP, navigation context, and session expiration details. Used exclusively for tracking temporary guest access without authentication.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client's IP address during session establishment.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current navigation URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Previous navigation URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp (30 minutes after creation).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_users
models.description: Registered user accounts with email/password credentials and authentication state. Supports role-based access control with user, admin, and super-admin levels for managing platform access. All user account operations are audited with timestamp tracking. The email field serves as the primary authentication identifier and requires unique verification.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address, validated and unique for authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: User role (user, admin, super-admin) governing access permissions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of user account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last user account update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of account deletion for soft deletes (NULL if active).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_user_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access (15min) and refresh (7day) validity for authenticated users. Stores connection metadata including IP, href, and referrer for security auditing and session management.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp, used for expiration tracking and analytics.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp (15 minutes from creation), enforced for security.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address where session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL where session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to session initiation.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_user_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for users with 15-minute expiration duration to recover account credentials. Manages temporary tokens generated during password recovery flow, each token valid for exactly 15 minutes before expiration.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string for password reset verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp (15 minutes after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Token creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Token last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for expired tokens.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_user_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for new user registration with expiration times and verification status tracking. Each token is tied to a user account and expires after a fixed period.

- Unique token required to prevent duplicate verification attempts
- Composed user_id + expires_at index enables efficient expiration checks
- Verification status tracks whether email was successfully validated

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user associated with this email verification token. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to user's email for account activation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: The expiration timestamp for the verification token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the verification token status.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was soft-deleted (if applicable).

plainFields.name: verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the associated email has been successfully verified.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_admins
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges and authentication state.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication.

plainFields.name: password
plainFields.description: Password for authentication.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: User role: 'user', 'admin', or 'super-admin'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (null if active).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_admin_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens with access (15min) and refresh (7day) validity for administrator accounts. Tracks session lifetime and client context for security.

Includes required fields for session management: access token expiration (15min) and refresh token validity (7day), client network context (IP, href, referrer), and audit timestamps for security monitoring.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator associated with this session. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The client IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The current URL path where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referring URL that led to the session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with 15-minute expiration for admin account recovery, storing verification tokens and expiration timestamps for security purposes.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: One-time verification token for password reset.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when password reset token expires (15 minutes after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was soft-deleted.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_admin_audit_logs
models.description:
Audit trail of all administrative actions including content moderation and user management, tracking admin identities, action types, and targets with exact timestamping.

This table captures all administrative operations performed by admins in the system, providing a historical record of actions taken against articles, sections, users, and other entities. The audit system ensures complete visibility into administrative decisions while maintaining referential integrity through the admin_id foreign key.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: The admin responsible for the action. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed (e.g., 'moderate_article', 'ban_user', 'update_section').

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity affected by action (e.g., 'article', 'user', 'section').

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the target entity affected by the action (UUID string), null when target is not applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when administrative action was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when audit log record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when audit log was soft-deleted (null for active records).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_sections
models.description:
Section definitions for organizing articles into economic and political topics, with unique name and descriptive metadata for user navigation.

Sections provide topic categorization for articles, enabling users to browse content by economic and political subtopics. Each section has a unique name (2-50 characters) and descriptive overview, allowing admins to manage topic structure without affecting existing content.

Section management allows creation, editing, and deletion of topics with proper content reassignment protocols (articles remain visible when sections are deleted).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique section name for topic identification. Matches requirement 6.1 (2-50 characters).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Section topic description for user context. Matches 6.1 requirement (5-250 characters).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when section was created. Standard required field.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when section was last modified. Standard required field.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when section was soft-deleted. Standard optional field for audit.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_articles
models.description: Stores user-published articles with content, title, section relationships, and metadata.

foreignFields.name: section_id
foreignFields.description: Section that the article belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_sections.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title (5-100 characters)

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Article content (minimum 100 characters)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was soft-deleted (null if active)

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
Manages file attachments linked to articles (5 max per article). Includes URL, file type (file/image), and timestamps with soft delete capability.

Attachment records are directly managed through content operations. Each attachment must belong to a single article, supporting the "Article has many Attachments" relationship pattern established in content management workflows.

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: File URL stored in cloud storage. URL must be valid and accessible.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: File type: 'file' or 'image'. Determines processing and display.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Automatically set on insertion.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Automatically updated on modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp if record was deactivated. Nullable.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_tags
models.description: Tracks user-defined tags for article categorization. Users can create, assign, and search tags across articles. Tags are unique and independent entities, allowing flexible categorization of content.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag identifier name (e.g., 'economy', 'politics'). Must be unique across all tags.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the tag.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (null if not deleted).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_tags
economic_political_discussion_board_comments
models.description: Holds user comments on articles with content and timestamping. Each comment belongs to a single article and user, with timestamps for creation and updates. Supports independent comment moderation, searching, and management workflows.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Comment content with minimum 10 characters, maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when comment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when comment was soft-deleted (nullable).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_admin_requests
models.description: Admin role promotion requests with status tracking and reason documentation

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Refers to the user requesting admin role promotion. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_users.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided for role promotion request.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the request (pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_bans
models.description: Tracks user bans with reason, ban status, and the administrator who applied the ban. Each ban entry is linked to the banned user and the administrator who initiated the ban, with soft delete support for audit trails.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the ban as provided by the administrator.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Indicates if ban is currently active (true) or lifted (false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when ban was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when ban was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when ban was soft-deleted.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_profiles
models.description: Stores user profile details including display name (2-30 characters) and bio (up to 250 characters), linked to user accounts via foreign key.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's public display name (2-30 characters)

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: User biography description (up to 250 characters)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of profile creation

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last profile update

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of profile deletion (soft delete)
